source.section: DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process

value.code: \pi^{+}(x_0\mid c):=\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid o=1,c)=\frac{p(o=1\mid x_0,c)\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid c)}{p_{\pi^{\mathrm{old}}}(o=1\mid c)}=\frac{r(x_0,c)}{p_{\pi^{\mathrm{old}}}(o=1\mid c)}\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid c).

\pi^{-}(x_0\mid c):=\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid o=0,c)=\frac{p(o=0\mid x_0,c)\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid c)}{p_{\pi^{\mathrm{old}}}(o=0\mid c)}=\frac{1-r(x_0,c)}{1-p_{\pi^{\mathrm{old}}}(o=1\mid c)}\pi^{\mathrm{old}}(x_0\mid c).
